type 71 3mark and guide equipment hardeningexperimental turborammer pretty standard stuff hardening for more hp to trade with and more track hp for when you cant just stay hulldown turbo to get around a bit quicker and rammer to boost the damage output experimental turbo over regular because the tank does a fine job of reaching its top speed anyways and doesnt desperately need that extra 1kmh forwards or backwards so being able to whip around a bit quicker and get better handling on quick peeks is pretty free not using experimental hardening for the ammo rack because it doesnt actually stop even midcaliber shots from damaging the module in 1 hit so it seems kinda pointless in that regard big guns wont pop it in 1 hit either way at least not with safe stowage and little guns can damage it in 1 hit either way maybe experimental makes it a bit less likely idk so ill just take the more concrete boosts to hptrack hp field mods rightleftrightleftleft track hp to get it high enough that other 400 alpha guns need significant highrolls to take them off in 1 hit accuracy view range and reverse speed as kinda nobrainers just relevant upsides with less relevant downsides and then the miscellaneous boosts on the last one due to the gun handling being good enough to make a teeny bit worse crew again pretty basic stuff if i got the 6th perks id roll with quick aiming or designated target if you like it controlled impact and i guess signal interception kinda out of relevant heavy perks respectively overview all in all the type 71 is a very nice tank in the current wot even if its not as easy as something like a canopener the armor isnt the most forgiving but its very good in a hulldown if you use it right and can still get some lucky bounces besides the gun is decent enough without the cooling mechanic similar to the e5s but a bit worse in every way but it gets incredibly consistent when you cool it which i find really delightful the grind itself was kinda ruined by the last day being some of the worst wot ive ever experienced taking what was just a couple good games away from being 5k in 70 games to what you see above but that certainly wasnt the tanks fault overall id say its a very enjoyable and capable vehicle and one thats well worth getting your hands on at least if you can stomach a bit of the more involvedhigh apm playstyle of the e5 gameplay tldr stay hulldown peek a lot to keep the damage stacking up in spite of low damage per shot and utilize quick peeksgunblockingkeeping the cupola behind the cover youre peeking from to avoid return damage simple in theory pretty handson in practice but i think its a very involved and rewarding playstyle i uploaded a handful of the bestmost interesting replays to wotrecord if you happen to want to see rather than read a wall of text first things first its a heavy so whats the armor situation well its a hulldown tank so the turret is the main thing youre looking at the turret face itself is very strong with even highpen guns needing to hit right next to the base of the gun to go through with consistency something which i think happened once in all the games i played the issue is of course the cupola which while not as big as the e5s also isnt something you can just make go away by using your gun depression the 12 degrees of gun depression that you achieve when using the hydroneumatic suspension will help you get shots out at enemies when almost no other heavy could but you do even then still need to be worried about keeping that cupola safe all of the same tactics that one would use to mitigate the cupola on the e5 still work here however and work even more effectively due to the already small size of said cupola the most ideal one is to hide the cupola behind cover when you peek something like the divider in the window on berlin or just any rockcorner that youre peeking around the left side of while you certainly wont always be able to hide the cupola in this way you can actually do it fairly often when that option isnt availabe the classic wiggling and gun blocking still work wonders just try to get used to quickly snapping your gun up and turning a bit right after you fire to try and block effectively while the turret armor is overall better than the e5 that does come at the cost of hull armor not only is the front of the hull weak enough to be succeptible to anything with normal pen but you also have those shoulder plates that largely preclude you from sidescraping id never try to rely on the hull armor either in a sidescrape or at an angle so just hide it or wiggle it when you cant youll still get some occasional lucky bounces or shots eaten by tracks sometimes that means going to different positions than you might expect for example on highway i just went field to fight the mediums rather than trying to play in a city where i cant hide the hull and that felt pretty good every time i did it it helps that your frontal armor is actually pretty effective against the verypopular ares line while you can just go straight through their turret fronts with ease even when using the gun depression the upper hull is pennable for normal gold straighton so be sure to be at a bit of an angle if you cant keep it fully hidden this is truly a hulldown tank not like an e5 or canopener that has some armor all around for making plays so leverage those hulldown positions to the fullest extent you can to do damage while saving hp and then expect to need to use that hp when you want to leave your hideyhole but you have 25k to throw around so you can afford to trade some for a better position while you dont have the same push potential as some of your peers you make up for it a bit in agility with this setup yielding a 46kmh top speed and 1881pw its not medium level but its quite responsive pair that with the snappiness and dpm of the gun as well as a 21kmh reverse speed and a pretty nice turret traverse speed and you get a tank that can react quite quickly to anything that gets thrown at it mobility also kind of includes the hydropneumatic suspension which with the buffed activation speed is actually fairly comfortable to use it helps that the tank has an okay 7 degrees of gun depression naturally but its also just reasonably easy to have it almost always active when youre wanting to be making peeks it felt a lot less awkward than some of my earlier experiences with the mechanic theres also an extra little upside in that due to how long the hull is and how far forward along that hull the turret is mounted the suspension pitching the tank forward can actually lower your turret enough to give you a bit of extra effective gun depression over the side though it still of course doesnt reach the levels it can over the front then the main interesting feature is of course the gun which is pretty great without cooling its basically just a worse e5 gun but not by that much the accuracy is still alright the gun handling is still pretty good those two stats are just about at ae phase i level not crazy but certainly qutie reliable and the dpm is nice heat vs apcr is a bit more subjective though the higher pen heat is generally better for heavies but apcr has nice strengths too its not an unrivaled level of consistent firepower like you get on the e5 but its quite solid then of course theres the gun cooling mechanic which while you wont want to wait for it on every shot will still come into effect several times per battle if you want to keep shooting every 7sec you have a perfectly reasonable gun but if you wait an extra 4sec either as a tactical choice or just because you dont have anything to shoot at you get accuracy that would make sniper tds jealous youre often just going to want to be peeking and shooting on reload to leverage the dpm but there are definitely a lot of times when its the right call to just wait a bit if an enemy is already preaimed on you and is in a position where they both arent super close and you need to hit a small weakspot of theirs letting the gun cool will give you the ability to do a super quick peek while still being pretty likely to hit which allowed me to peek into enemies and still be the only one to deal damage quite a few times its also just a great option to have when you have time to aim before you need to fall back and would rather wait 4sec to almost guarantee a hit than 7sec to try again after taking an iffy shot thats mostly for shooting cupolas at middistances though but that does come up a lot most of the time youre probably not going to want to actively wait for it to cool and youll just wanna roll with the base stats and occasional hyperaccurate shots when thats how the timing works out but waiting on it is a valuable tool to keep in mind hopefully that just about covers everything but if not feel free to ask any questions you might have ill get out ahead of a couple though i have not played any of the other heavies in the line before or after this one so i cant really speak on how they feel to playgrind
